name: iso42001
title: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 (AI management systems) — Annex A.6.2.8 event-logging slice
description: A single-control profile. ISO 42001 is a management-system standard; CIS-2's only genuine, sourced fit is Annex A.6.2.8 (AI system recording of event logs), and that row rests on a compliance vendor's paraphrase since the standard itself is paywalled (see compliance/CROSSWALK.md row 20 and its honest verdict). This profile does not and cannot demonstrate ISO 42001 certification readiness.

vectors.crosswalk_control: CROSSWALK.md row 20 (Annex A.6.2.8 event log recording)
vectors.rationale: A schema-valid receipt is a concrete enabled event-log mechanism for the inference-execution phase of the AI system lifecycle.
Tamper-evidence of the log strengthens the 'recording of event logs' control beyond a plain unlinked log file.
Demonstrates the event log actually detects the tamper/replay classes of integrity failure a log is supposed to catch.

not_covered: The entire ISO 42001 management-system scope: roles, resourcing, risk assessment, supplier controls, monitoring, continual improvement -- audited by an accredited certification body, not producible by any test suite.
Every other ISO 42001 Annex A control besides A.6.2.8 -- not assessed in compliance/CROSSWALK.md and therefore not in this profile either.
Certification itself -- a receipt is audit evidence for one control, not a substitute for the accredited external audit ISO 42001 certification requires.
Primary ISO clause text was never independently obtained (paywalled) -- this whole profile rests on a secondary paraphrase, a real sourcing weakness carried over honestly from CROSSWALK.md.
